fact: SPIN (the Gabonese backbone holder) reports that the Gabonese and Equatoguinean ministers officially inaugurated on 10 November 2025 the physical and logical interconnection of the two countries' national fibre backbones at Meyo-Kyé/Ebebeyin, with tests confirming stable traffic exchange between Bitam and Ebebeyin and between Libreville and Bata.
system: Interconnexion des dorsales nationales Gabon - Guinée équatoriale (Backbone National Gabonais - Equatoguinean national fibre network)

fact: TechAfrica News reports that Gabon and Equatorial Guinea signed a bilateral agreement on 10 November 2025 in Mongomo, between the two digital-economy ministers, on interconnection of the two countries' fibre-optic networks.
system: Interconnection of fibre-optic networks, Gabon - Equatorial Guinea
